name: Shure MV7 / MV7+
author: Joel Gaff, Jr.
description: Control Shure MV7 and MV7+ microphones from the bar with model-specific gain, Auto Level, headphone mix, processing, LEDs and presets. Driven by shurectl --follow (the joelgaff/shurectl fork, built by install.sh).

barWidget.description: Mute, gain, headphone mix, processing and presets for Shure MV7 and MV7+ (needs the joelgaff/shurectl fork; run install.sh)

schema.label: shurectl binary
schema.description: Path to a shurectl that has --follow (empty: ~/.local/bin/shurectl, where install.sh puts it).

schema.label: Poll interval (ms)
schema.description: How often the mic is read so its own mute button and MOTIV app changes show up.

schema.label: Scroll step (%)
schema.description: How much scrolling changes the headphone mix: toward computer audio on MV7, or mic volume on MV7+.
